title: Roady: Agent Handoff & Cross-Project Planning
description:
Roady planning system roadmap:
- v0.5.0 (complete): Horizons 5 & 6 — predictive analytics, domain hardening, event sourcing.
- v0.6.0 (complete): Multi-repo org dashboard, plugin contracts, notification webhooks, fsnotify watch,
  coordinator integration into CLI/MCP with snapshot and task queries.
- v0.7.0 (complete): Org policy inheritance, cross-project drift, plugin registry and health,
  Slack/realtime notifications, watch auto-sync and patterns.
- v0.8.0 (complete): Developer experience polish, API/SDK stability, multi-user collaboration,
  AI-powered workflows, interactive D3 MCP app visualizations.
- v0.9.0 (complete): Expert-review-driven refinements — sharpen onboarding, reduce CLI
  cognitive load, ship a pre-seeded demo, fix empty-state UX.
- v0.10.0 (complete): AI quality and telemetry — eval harness over the planning
  pipeline (heuristic + AI mock + drift corpus), Task.Origin provenance, source-doc
  citations through spec analyze, CompletionResponse confidence + sources +
  streaming OnToken contract, MCP tool consolidation (roady_tasks +
  roady_cost_estimate), naming standardisation aliases, roady notify namespace
  unification, AI command progress feedback with SIGINT cancellation.
- v0.11.0 (complete): Positioning and narrative cleanup — single ICP picked
  (devs using AI coding agents), category named ("Planning memory for AI
  coding agents"), README hero rewritten, feature museum moved to
  docs/advanced.md, docs/vs.md competitive comparison + docs/positioning.md
  one-pager + ROADMAP.md sketch shipped, Astro website hero / definition /
  features sections realigned to match.
    - v0.12.0 (complete): Live Kanban dashboard, cross-project board, SSE updates,
      dashboard auth token.
    - v0.13.x (complete): Release pipeline — dedicated release workflow, cask
      publishing, cleared goreleaser deprecations.
    - v0.14.0 (complete): Coordination and stakeholder reporting without a UI —
      owner-scoped task queries, per-owner WIP limits, enforceable team roles,
      `roady report`, `roady notify digest`, agent/session provenance on every
      event, `roady audit trail`, bidirectional tracker sync, parallel-safe
      event logs with `roady state rebuild`. Web dashboard removed.
    - v0.15.0 (complete): Roady stopped calling language models. Provider clients
      removed; the model-assisted operations return assembled prompts plus the
      tool that accepts the result. MCP tool failures became readable results
      rather than masked protocol faults. MCP schema 3.0.0.
    - v0.16.0 (complete): staleness drift detection, audit-verification
      correctness (three causes, none of them tampering), and plan prune
      cleaning execution state.
    - v0.17.0 (complete): roady_audit_trail exposed over MCP; schema 3.1.0.
    - Planned (unversioned until it ships): the features below.

features.title: Cross-project task dependencies
features.description: An org-level plan can express that a task in one sub-project waits on a task in another.

requirements.title: Parse @project:task-id in DependsOn
requirements.description: DependsOn accepts @project:task-id and resolves it to the named sub-project.

requirements.title: Validate cross-project DAGs
requirements.description: Cycle detection and readiness checks span sub-projects, so a cross-project cycle is refused.

requirements.title: Readiness honours cross-project edges
requirements.description: A task blocked by another project is not reported ready, in CLI and MCP alike.

features.title: Per-task subagent dispatch
features.description: roady task start can hand a ready task to a subagent with its spec source attached and a deterministic completion hook.

requirements.title: Define the dispatch contract
requirements.description: A task handed to a subagent carries its spec citation, acceptance criteria, and the tool to report completion through.

requirements.title: Deterministic completion hook
requirements.description: A dispatched task completes through a recorded transition, so the audit trail attributes the work to that agent and session.

features.title: Spec-to-PR loop
features.description: CI detects drift on PR merge and either accepts it or opens a follow-up issue.

requirements.title: Drift gate for CI
requirements.description: A documented CI job runs drift detect on merge and fails or reports based on severity.

requirements.title: Open a follow-up for unaccepted drift
requirements.description: Drift left unaccepted after merge becomes a tracked issue rather than a silent divergence.

features.title: Drift explainer follow-ups
features.description: Drift explanation extends to a prompt that asks for a PR-ready diff, consistent with Roady running no inference itself.

requirements.title: Emit an explain-and-patch prompt
requirements.description: roady drift explain can emit a request whose expected format is a patch, with the write-back tool named.

features.title: Cross-repo planning
features.description: A single .roady/ workspace declares member repos, shares spec context, and aggregates plan state.

requirements.title: Declare member repositories
requirements.description: A workspace lists member repos and resolves their .roady/ directories.

requirements.title: Aggregate plan state across members
requirements.description: Status, report, and drift span every member repo in one view.

constraints.description: Maintain backward compatibility with existing spec.yaml and plan.json formats
Achieve 80%+ test coverage on new packages
Follow existing DDD patterns and naming conventions
All new CLI commands should have corresponding MCP tools
